writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the hypnosis guide lane's writer (the splices and their fixes; the words are Emulate's)

findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
examples: It’s all soup to you at that point.
findings.reason: It ends the paragraph as the approved "It's all just soup." did: his own image (published: "long elegant sentences become soup during an induction"), and "at that point" places it in the induction; it doesn't sum the paragraph up.

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite of the words it replaces (SOURCE.txt), so it follows their points in order by design; the turns are Emulate's own ("And then", "NOT going to help you", "soup to you at that point").

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The guide speaks to the reader as "you" throughout; here "you" is the person writing the script and going into the trance, in the paragraph's two steps.
